hero.title: Connect your systems. Simplify your integrations.
hero.description: The Hub is a synchronization platform that connects systems through a shared data model and reusable connectors.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.business: Install connectors, configure integrations and manage data exchange between your systems.
howItWorks.development: Build reusable connectors and distribute them to organizations that need to integrate their systems.

dataModel.title: A shared data model
dataModel.description: Connect different systems through a common protocol.

permissions.title: Permissions under your control
permissions.description: Define which information each integration can read and modify.

visibility.title: Synchronization visibility
visibility.description: Monitor the status and activity of your integrations.

security.title: Security and control
security.description: The Hub's security model is based on project roles, explicit integration permissions and independent credentials for each connector.

platform.question: What is The Hub?
platform.answer: A platform for synchronizing data between systems through connectors.

business.question: What is a Business project?
business.answer: A workspace where organizations install connectors, configure integrations and manage permissions.

development.question: What is a Development project?
development.answer: A workspace where developers build, configure and distribute connectors.

technical.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
technical.answer: Installing and configuring an existing connector does not require building an integration from scratch. Creating new connectors requires programming knowledge.

metadata.description: A data synchronization platform powered by reusable connectors.
